# Signature Aura Developers (Signature Aura Pvt. Ltd.)
> Premier Luxury Real Estate Advisory & Development Firm in India.
> Headquartered at Office No. 812, Millennium Towers, Baner-Sus Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411021.

Signature Aura Pvt. Ltd. (branded as Signature Aura™ and Signature Aura Developers) is an institutional real estate advisory and private asset consultancy representing high-net-worth individuals (HNIs), family offices, corporate CXOs, and global NRIs.

## Core Architectural & Transaction Specialties
1. **Baner-Sus & Western Pune Prime Corridors:** Exclusive builder joint ventures, IT park corporate floors, and marquee penthouses in Baner, Balewadi High Street, Sus, and Koregaon Park.
2. **South Mumbai Trophy Sky Residences:** Sea-facing triplex penthouses and sky mansions on Worli Sea Face, Bandra West, and BKC corporate plates.
3. **Goa Luxury Freehold Estates:** Freehold Portuguese villas, private plunge pools, and beach retreats across Assagao and Candolim.
4. **Delhi NCR & Cyber Corridors:** Super-luxury condominiums along Golf Course Road, DLF Camellias corridor, and Connaught Place retail flagships.
5. **30-Year Forensic Title Due Diligence:** High-court advocate certified 30-year search reports, mutation trace, and statutory MahaRERA compliance audits prior to earnest deposit.
6. **Global NRI Advisory Desk:** End-to-end FEMA and RBI repatriation guidance, Form 15CA/CB documentation, NRE/NRO remittance structures, and remote Power of Attorney (PoA) execution.
